role: Design and field-notes document for the Flo assistant's routing (Quick/Auto/Deep/Manual), tool-use pipeline, fact catalog contents, voice conversation mechanics (audio session, barge-in, timeouts), prompt rules and known failure modes.

units.key: § Voice Conversation & Tool Use
units.does: Claims the chat tab is Flo, the mid-workout voice is Coach ('Coach here.'), the email is a Flo Report, sharing model picker and history. Verified: AssistantSubsystem.voiceAnnouncement returns 'Flo here.' for .coach/.voiceConversation, 'Coach here.' for .workoutVoiceCoach, 'Flo Report.' for .coachReport (AIProvider.swift:144-151).

units.key: § Voice Conversation & Tool Use > Adaptive routing (Quick / Auto / Deep / Manual)
units.does: Claims routing acts only when Apple Intelligence is selected (TurnRouter.preTierDecision returns the user's pick otherwise, and the picker is disabled); with Apple selected the chat has no text composer (prefab chips and voice are the input), so routed text turns are chip questions; Quick keeps chip turns on Apple; Auto uses the capability classifier and maps to consented Grok then DeepSeek, else Apple; Deep uses the same mid-tier cloud; Manual uses the picker; voice and action turns go to the first consented cloud. Verified: preTierDecision (TurnRouter.swift), ChatInputBar.composer shows appleOnlyComposerHint when Apple is active (AssistantChatSupport.swift:128-134), TierProviderMapper.midTierProvider iterates [.grok, .deepseek] with consent, routingModePicker .disabled when non-Apple.

units.key: § Voice Conversation & Tool Use > Adaptive routing (Quick / Auto / Deep / Manual) > Capability-axis classifier
units.does: Claims four binary axes (needsTools, needsWeb, needsHistoricalDepth, needsSpeculation), each firing only when a keyword marker AND embedding cosine >= 0.55 agree; 0 flags → .quick, 1 → .auto, >=2 → .deep; CapabilityClassifierTests has 19 cases. Verified axisThreshold 0.55 (CapabilityClassifier.swift:60) and the AND gate (CapabilityClassifier.swift:138-145).

units.key: § Voice Conversation & Tool Use > Adaptive routing (Quick / Auto / Deep / Manual) > Voice-mode bypass
units.does: Claims voice turns bypass SmartProviderRouter: with Apple selected (any mode but Manual), TurnRouter.appleVoiceBypass sends voice to the first consented cloud in registry order on its default model; key entry is not consent; no consented cloud → Apple; any other pick answers voice itself. Verified TurnRouter.swift:155-197.

units.key: § Voice Conversation & Tool Use > Adaptive routing (Quick / Auto / Deep / Manual) > Stickiness rules (typed turns, Auto mode)
units.does: Claims sticky tiering: upgrades always adopted; within settling window (turns 1-3) take proposal; post-settle downgrade only when classifier returns Requirement.none and proposal is .quick; else keep higher tier. Verified SmartProviderRouter.stickyTier (SmartProviderRouter.swift:84-95, settlingTurns = 3, turnCount < 3).

units.key: § Voice Conversation & Tool Use > Adaptive routing (Quick / Auto / Deep / Manual) > Action-intent override
units.does: Claims providerSupportsTools is false for Apple, so a turn resolved to Apple whose text messageRequiresTools flags goes to the first consented cloud in registry order; none consented → stays on Apple.

units.key: § Voice Conversation & Tool Use > Adaptive routing (Quick / Auto / Deep / Manual) > Embedding fallback chain
units.does: Claims embedding chain NLContextualEmbedding → NLEmbedding.wordEmbedding → keyword-only, with the ~50 MB asset download kicked off once on first launch via Task.detached { try? await requestAssets() }. Code kicks the download lazily the first time the contextual embedder is touched (first classification), not at launch (SmartProviderRouter.swift:103-125), and repeats the request on each launch until assets exist.

units.key: § Voice Conversation & Tool Use > Adaptive routing (Quick / Auto / Deep / Manual) > Adversarial-spend cap
units.does: Claims a daily Tier-3 ceiling of 50 turns (dailyTier3Cap) counting Deep turns that resolve to a cloud model, per local date in UserDefaults; once exceeded, Deep proposals downgrade to Auto for the day; states this changes only the tier label, since with Apple selected TierProviderMapper maps .deep and .auto to the same consented mid-tier cloud and model, so the cap does not limit spend. Verified dailyTier3Cap = 50 and recordTier3UsageAndCheck (SmartProviderRouter.swift:50,195-203), makeTierStageInputs counts only cloud-resolved Deep (AssistantViewModel+Routing.swift:88-101), autoMapping/deepMapping (TierProviderMapper.swift:81-101).

units.key: § Voice Conversation & Tool Use > Adaptive routing (Quick / Auto / Deep / Manual) > Deterministic intent shortcut
units.does: Claims DeterministicIntent.tryMatch runs before any LLM call with a 14-pattern catalog (lists the ids), first match wins, no confidence gate, falling through when data is missing. Verified 14 ids at DeterministicIntent.swift:113-384 and tryMatch (410-421) called from AssistantViewModel.swift:458.

units.key: § Voice Conversation & Tool Use > Adaptive routing (Quick / Auto / Deep / Manual) > Tier indicator on chat bubbles
units.does: Claims each assistant turn carries routedTierRaw and ChatBubble renders a 6-pt dot green=Quick, blue=Auto, purple=Deep; Manual and voice-bypass turns have nil tier. Code renders a 6x6 Circle plus a 'Quick/Auto/Deep tier' text label, coloured AppTheme.sage/primary/dustyRose (ChatBubble.swift:22-37, 303-313).

units.key: § Voice Conversation & Tool Use > Adaptive routing (Quick / Auto / Deep / Manual) > AFM prewarm
units.does: Claims AppleFoundationProvider.prewarm() (idempotent, detached, .utility) runs on the first send when routing might land on Apple: Quick/Auto, or Manual with Apple selected. Code calls it on every send when mode != .deep and (mode != .manual or active is Apple) (AssistantViewModel.swift:480-489).

units.key: § Voice Conversation & Tool Use > Adaptive routing (Quick / Auto / Deep / Manual) > Voice preamble names the model
units.does: Claims the voice-session earcon names the model ('Flo here. Sonnet.'), via VoiceConversationController.currentModelDisplayName. Verified announced() (Speech.swift:88-97) and currentModelDisplayName (114-124) using the responding turn's provider.

units.key: § Voice Conversation & Tool Use > Adaptive routing (Quick / Auto / Deep / Manual) > Cache health telemetry
units.does: Claims LLMCacheTelemetry.shared records per-provider cache hits on usage events and Settings → Troubleshooting → AI cache health shows cumulative + last-10-turn ratios with reset, on-device only. Verified: record (LLMCacheTelemetry.swift:81) fed from AssistantViewModel+Tools.swift:317; recentHitRatio(turns: 10); card in SettingsPages+Diagnostics.swift:151-205; counters are in-memory 'since app launch'.

units.key: § Voice Conversation & Tool Use > How the assistant fetches data
units.does: Claims every provider including Apple uses tool use; Apple gets a compacted instruction prefix for its 4K window.

units.key: § Voice Conversation & Tool Use > How the assistant fetches data > Tool-use path (all providers)
units.does: Claims the model is given a compact meta-schema (CompactToolRouter: get_* tools + lookup_fact) over a 200+ entry catalog; tool_use blocks resolve via CompactToolRouter.resolveTool → FactResolverRegistry; hard cap 8 tool calls per turn (maxToolCallsPerTurn), with the 9th returning a synthetic missing envelope and one more model pass. Verified maxToolCallsPerTurn = 8 on AssistantToolRunner (AssistantViewModel+Tools.swift:30).

units.key: § Voice Conversation & Tool Use > How the assistant fetches data > Apple Intelligence — tool wiring + verbatim compaction
units.does: Claims Apple tools are wrapped by AppleToolCatalog.wrap (21 read + up to 19 action tools), dispatched via AppleToolDispatcher.shared with setRegistry before each Apple send, returning FactValue.toToolResultJSON; AppleContextCompactor enforces 4,096-token window compacting at 70%; SessionCache reuses a session, rotating after 20 turns or when the token estimate would overflow; replies capped at 512 tokens. Verified contextWindow 4096 and compactionThreshold 0.70 (AppleContextCompactor.swift:43-48), maxTurnsPerSession = 20 (AppleFoundationProvider.swift:117), maximumResponseTokens = responseReserve (446), setRegistry at AssistantViewModel+Routing.swift:563, 19 allowedActionNames.

units.key: § Voice Conversation & Tool Use > How the assistant fetches data > What's in the catalog
units.does: Claims the catalog has 21 top-level namespaces and ~240 entries, plus specific namespaces/keys: location.* with 5-minute cache / 5 s cold fetch, directions.* (arrived within 25 m), breadcrumb.* (recent = newest 10), score.algorithm.version 'v3.2.oct2026', comeback mode HRV 80/Sleep 20/Vitals 0 vs 60/25/15 for 21 days, vitals.hr_now 10-minute gate, workout.live.* keys, route_topology climbs capped at 5, weather 30-min TTL from MET Norway, workout.power.*, app.*, assistant.memory.*, road context refreshed every ~15 m or ~60 s, web.* with curated research/manufacturer domain lists and exclusions, routes.library.* reads and rename/save_workout actions. Verified: 238 distinct keys/patterns across exactly 21 prefixes; ActiveRouteSession arrival 25 m (ActiveRouteSession.swift:193); breadcrumb prefix(10); RecoveryScoreCalculator.swift:7-15 weights; WeatherService.cacheTTL 30*60; RoadGeocodingService movementThresholdMeters 15 / timeThresholdSec 60; WebSearchService domain lists match the doc.

units.key: § Voice Conversation & Tool Use > How the assistant fetches data > Mutation tools (`[ACTION]`)
units.does: Claims mutation tools carry an [ACTION] description prefix, may only be called on explicit instruction, return old/new values for read-back, surface invalidParameter disambiguation, never self-undo, and that memory remove/clear and contacts remove only record a pending request (AssistantActionConfirmations) and return confirmation_required with an app-written ask_user question, running when the same call comes back and the user's next message is a short explicit yes (AffirmationReply: ≤5 words, no negation); another reply, an intervening turn or ten minutes cancels; memory.restore undoes the last confirmed wipe until the app quits. Lists CompactToolRouter.allowedActionNames as artifacts add/update_status, route rename/save_workout/engage, contacts add/remove, email compose, memory add/remove/clear/restore, web search, location current/detailed/situation, set address, directions routeTo/clear; no monthly/year-over-year aggregation facts.

units.key: § Voice Conversation & Tool Use > Voice conversation flow
units.does: no behavioural claim beyond: the top-left mic toggles a continuous voice conversation distinct from the dictation mic next to the text field.

units.key: § Voice Conversation & Tool Use > Voice conversation flow > Audio session
units.does: Claims voice uses .playAndRecord with mode .measurement through AudioSessionCoordinator (single owner of setCategory; voice's category wins over BackgroundAudioManager's .workoutCue claim); recogniser errors 1110 / kLSRErrorDomain 301 auto-restart with a 1.5 s cooldown; a system interruption tears the session down with no auto-resume. Verified: AudioSessionCoordinator.apply uses .measurement when a record claim exists (AudioSessionCoordinator.swift:141); recognitionRestartCooldownSec = 1.5 (VoiceConversationController.swift:191); handleAudioInterruption (Audio.swift:73-99).

units.key: § Voice Conversation & Tool Use > Voice conversation flow > Barge-in (interrupting the AI)
units.does: Claims four gates all required for barge-in: 600 ms grace, RMS above threshold sustained 300 ms, >= 2 new recognized words, Jaccard echo rejection; plus a Send now push-to-talk button. Verified checkForBargeIn (Speech.swift:524-537) with bargeInGracePeriodSec 0.6, bargeInSustainedSec 0.3, bargeInMinNewWords 2 and VoiceEchoHeuristics.isEchoOfInFlightResponse; it additionally requires state == .speaking and synthesizer.isSpeaking.

units.key: § Voice Conversation & Tool Use > Voice conversation flow > Stop-button behavior
units.does: Claims Stop and the mic toggle cancel the LLM stream, stop the synthesizer immediately, drop pending TTS and block late tool chunks via Task.checkCancellation between events and tool rounds. Verified checkCancellation in resolveToolCalls (AssistantViewModel+Tools.swift:409-414).

units.key: § Voice Conversation & Tool Use > Voice conversation flow > Turn timeouts
units.does: Claims 30 s max turn, 3 s no-growth commit when >= 4 chars captured, 1.2 s end-of-turn silence. Verified maxTurnDurationSec 30, stalledTranscriptCommitSec 3.0, stalledTranscriptMinChars 4, endOfTurnSilenceSec 1.2 (VoiceConversationController.swift:334-348).

units.key: § Voice Conversation & Tool Use > What the assistant will not do
units.does: no behavioural claim: section heading for prompt rules.

units.key: § Voice Conversation & Tool Use > What the assistant will not do > Data honesty
units.does: Claims system prompt forbids fabrication: only numbers from tool results/context, stop on missing, never deny user-reported claims, state missing capability once. Verified rules in AIProvider+SystemPromptText.swift:71, :90 and the tool overlay's prescribed refusal (:466-471).

units.key: § Voice Conversation & Tool Use > What the assistant will not do > Sports-science framing rules
units.does: Claims prompt rules: translate jargon, score is HRV 60 / Sleep 25 / Vitals 15 with training load excluded, no risk-prediction framings. Prompt text at AIProvider+SystemPromptText.swift:111-120 and :723-724 also states the 70/30 and comeback 80/20 variants.

units.key: § Voice Conversation & Tool Use > What the assistant will not do > Voice-mode brevity
units.does: Claims a voice overlay appends '1–3 sentences, no markdown…' for voice sends. Verified VOICE MODE block (AIProvider+SystemPromptText.swift:755) appended after base (AIProvider+SystemPrompt.swift:130).

units.key: § Voice Conversation & Tool Use > What the assistant will not do > Always-on brevity (2026-04-29)
units.does: Claims a BREVITY block applies to all sends (lead with number, 1-3 sentences, never emit <data> blocks) and that the tool overlay's '<data>' quoting instruction was replaced by 'Extract silently, then answer'. Verified BREVITY (SystemPromptText.swift:21-28) and rule 2 (:458-464).

units.key: § Voice Conversation & Tool Use > Known failure modes
units.does: no behavioural claim: heading for known failure modes.

units.key: § Voice Conversation & Tool Use > Known failure modes > Barge-in misses
units.does: Claims speech below about -35 dBFS (bargeInRMSThreshold) won't pass gate 2 and single words don't interrupt. bargeInRMSThreshold = 0.018 linear ≈ -34.9 dBFS (VoiceConversationController.swift:405); bargeInMinNewWords = 2.

units.key: § Voice Conversation & Tool Use > Known failure modes > Barge-in false positives
units.does: no behavioural claim: field observation that speakerphone echo can defeat the Jaccard gate.

units.key: § Voice Conversation & Tool Use > Known failure modes > Tool-use accuracy
units.does: no behavioural claim: field observations on provider tool-call accuracy and ISO-date retries.

units.key: § Voice Conversation & Tool Use > Known failure modes > Provider pinning
units.does: no behavioural claim: provider model-ID pinning notes (not verified against ProviderRegistry model lists).

units.key: § Voice Conversation & Tool Use > Known failure modes > Apple on-device limitations
units.does: Claims Apple has tool use, AppleContextCompactor drops oldest turns verbatim at 70% of budget, multi-week trends push the classifier to .auto/.deep.

units.key: § Voice Conversation & Tool Use > Known failure modes > Hallucinations we've actually observed
units.does: no behavioural claim: anecdotes of observed hallucinations (sleep efficiency 9592% unit bug fixed).

units.key: § Voice Conversation & Tool Use > Files that matter
units.does: Table of files that matter. All linked files exist. Places dispatch loop + voice bypass + budget in AssistantViewModel.swift and system-prompt overlays in AIProvider.swift.

units.key: § Voice Conversation & Tool Use > Status
units.does: Status list: classifier 4 axes >=0.55; routing only with Apple; voice bypass; Apple tool wiring; 70%-of-4K compaction; 14 deterministic patterns; earcon; cache telemetry; <live_state> in last user tail; Anthropic cache breakpoints; sorted-keys JSON; 4-gate barge-in; 8-call budget; 30 s / 3 s timeouts; 1110/301 restart; 5 s first-partial watchdog; 45 s long-idle restart; per-turn engine restart; FactResolverRegistry rate limiter on 3rd consecutive missing, 80 KB output cap, resolver timing warnings at 0.5 s and 2 s with the value kept; 8 catalog-validation tests; 5 composites; 2026-08 additions incl. sleep.latest/vitals.latest live HealthKit fallback with a 5 s timeout whose late answer the registry keeps; deferred items. Verified firstPartialTimeoutSec 5.0, longIdleRestartSec 45.0, outputSizeCapBytes 80_000, defaultResolveBudgetSec 2.0, resolveWarnBudgetSec 0.5, FactResolverRegistry.resolveTool/logResolveDuration keep the value (FactResolverRegistry.swift:342-412), <live_state> appended in Anthropic/Gemini/OpenAI-compatible providers, FactCatalogValidationTests has 8 test functions.
